This '''Jedi Master''' was one of the first members of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]].

==Biography==
In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the Jedi Master was among the first of the New Jedi Order to reach that prestigious [[Jedi Master/Legends|rank]]; furthermore, he was one of the six Jedi who were assigned students by Master Skywalker to train to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knighthood]], in a practice mirroring the Master/[[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] system of old. Later that same year he was a member of the strike force of Jedi Knights that traveled to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|prevent]] the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] from resurrecting their [[Marka Ragnos|namesake]].<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>
When [[Jaden Korr]] reached the stairway that led to the [[Tomb of Marka Ragnos]], the individual known as "Jedi Master" was opposing some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], a [[New Reborn]], and a couple of [[Sith cultist/Legends|Sith Cultists]]. It is unknown whether the individual survived the battle.

==Lightsaber==
The Jedi Master wielded a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaff]], a rarity among members of the [[New Jedi Order]]. It had a vindicator-style hilt and [[Color/Legends|green]] blades.<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JKA_jedimaster.png|thumb|left|The Jedi Master with his lightsaber|150px]]
The Jedi Master was a character in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''. He was voiced by [[Dominic Armato]] and [[Dee Bradley Baker]].

In addition to being used for the original character described above, the Jedi Master's skin was also used as a stand-in for pre-established Jedi for whom a unique skin was unavailable. [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], possibly [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]] and [[Streen]] are all represented by the Jedi Master skin during cutscenes.<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

It is possible for the Jedi Master to survive [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|the battle]] if the player helps him.
